svg.title: How boxrunner gets a job onto your box
svg.desc: How a job reaches your box. 1: the agent on your box opens a session with the Worker, using the box token. 2: the Worker, which holds the GitHub App key, creates the scale set and session on GitHub. 3: the agent long-polls GitHub's queue with a session token. 4: when a job waits, the agent fetches one runner config from the Worker and starts a container. 5: the container runs exactly one job and is then removed.
